title: MSHvSF CPS-2 versus Saturn difference ledger
scope: Facts established through the deterministic Saturn normal-hit first pass

entries.observable: CPS-2 is audited as a MAME ROM set with key and QSound dependency; the Saturn reference is a mixed-mode disc with one data track, eleven audio tracks, and an ISO9660 filesystem.
entries.falsification: A fresh manifest shows a different audited source layout or disc track layout.

entries.observable: The Saturn data track exposes a flat 414-file root with large ST2 families, PAC packages, ADP files, and executable-looking BIN members.
entries.falsification: The raw-sector ISO parser fails against an independent manifest or reports a directory hierarchy.

entries.observable: The Saturn port now has a deterministic Ryu route covering idle, walk, jump, standing normal, collision, visible health response, hit reaction, and recovery. Exact paired mechanics and the Saturn Hadouken path remain unmeasured.
evidence: Two Saturn cold replays produced 25 identical screenshot hashes.
entries.falsification: Paired CPS-2 and Saturn measurements establish a specific match, adaptation, alteration, or reduction.

entries.observable: The official port boots with Yaba Sanshiro configured for a 32 Mbit expansion cartridge.
entries.falsification: Controlled boots with cartridge configurations plus memory traces establish a more specific role.

guardrail: Absence of paired Saturn gameplay evidence is not evidence of a reduction or alteration.
